tables.title: Observed numerical and statistical limits
rows: Ordinary lognormal AFT, n=128, zero entry
The recorded coverage lower bound is 0.937081, leaving the study inconclusive
Assess this configuration separately from the ordinary AFT cells that met the study criterion
Ordinary Weibull AFT, n=128, positive entry
The coverage lower bound is 0.939556, with one unavailable fit among 10,000 requested
Include unavailable fits when assessing the coverage of the complete procedure
Repeated-spell fixed-effect and dependent spatial survival Wald inference
The independent-row ordinary AFT study leaves these settings unassessed
Use evidence matching the repeated or dependent observations
High-censoring spatial log-time likelihood integration
Recorded 50% and 80% censoring stress cases miss the numerical target, including selected high-budget cases
Distinguish convergence and refinement stability from a bound on integration error
Preliminary spatial-survival stress records
The source record lacks the manifest identifying the code before execution
Treat the observations as preliminary when relating them to the current implementation
Gaussian SAR Wald inference
The 48-unit cell exceeds the size budget and the 96-unit cell is inconclusive
Treat Wald inference in these small samples as approximate
Pooled SAC panel optimization, seed 0, T=30, N=9
Independent searches with fixed and repeated graph storage can stop at different points. In float64 the repeated-graph candidate fails the average profile-score tolerance and is unavailable
Include stalled attempts in the accounting. The acceptance guard withholds the candidate without finding an optimum
Random-effects SEM panel, CPU float64, seed 26310, T=6, N=8, tolerance 1e-8
The solver converges at the spatial boundary -0.999 and the boundary guard withholds the fit
Count the unavailable procedure among attempted fits, since supported inputs can yield boundary solutions
Stationary-bootstrap mean interval, T=256
The independent normal cell is inconclusive and the AR(1) coefficient 0.3 cell undercovers
Use coverage evidence for the dependence and interval construction in your data
Public Sharpe confidence interval, T=128
Gaussian, skewed and dependent-return cells report excess error under the prespecified coverage criterion
Restrict conclusions to the interval construction and return model assessed
Canonical dyadic node bootstrap
The manual-only study remains unexecuted in the source record
Describe this study as unexecuted when presenting evidence for the procedure
Correlated GMS QLR and Wolak projections in float32
Tested two- and three-moment examples include unconverged calculations. Float64 reference tolerances exceed the accuracy available in float32
Inspect convergence and preserve unavailable trials. Reassess accuracy after an explicit change in precision

tables.title: Other limits to consider
rows: Ordination
Negative inertia and prediction capabilities depend on the fitted geometry
Read the signed spectrum and prediction contract in the ordination reference
Selected-mixture equivalence
The approximate percentile bootstrap lacks a proved Type I bound
Interpret conclusions within the evidence for the chosen equivalence procedure
Multiplicity adjustment
Holm and Bonferroni need valid individual true-null p-values
Check the underlying tests before adjusting their p-values
Survival restricted means
Bounded quadrature or incomplete-gamma underflow can leave a finite integral numerically unavailable
Preserve unavailable values and inspect prediction diagnostics
OLS residual diagnostics
The size study covers one 200-row Gaussian design with asymptotic references
Assess other sample sizes, power and non-Gaussian settings separately
Resampling
Failure policies vary between entry points
Report the requested, successful and failed draw counts
